stratification: Dominant oil/look-alike pixel class per source image; 16/8 images. Three oil pixels in image32 retained.
eligibility: 24 matching dimensions; full MAT finite/nine-channel/hash checks and visual review required before fitting. No resizing of 17 mismatched pairs. Stop and version protocol if a structural failure changes the population.
split_scope: Connected exact-overlap groups kept intact. Sampled overlap screening does not establish scene independence or exclude radiometrically changed/rotated overlap.

feature_image.channel: T[:,:,0] (publisher T11); not Sentinel VV or 8-bit DN
feature_image.filter: Lee, window7, looks4 on nonnegative linear T11
feature_image.transform: 10*log10(max(filtered,1e-12)); per-image 1st/99th percentiles, clip and scale to [0,1]; constant range gives zeros
feature_image.features: Existing eight core.features: area_fraction, elongation, extent, complexity, mean, std, boundary_gradient, background_contrast
feature_image.rationale: Frozen SOS Lee setting transferred for this supplementary experiment, not claimed optimal for QPOSD. Per-image scaling uses no labels. SVM/CART feature scaling fit on train objects only.

conditional_classification.training_objects: All exact-color 8-connected oil/look-alike reference regions in train, including <64 pixels; no area-based removal
conditional_classification.selection: Highest validation macro-F1 across oil and look-alike; exact ties use model list order. NumPy backend; nonconverged fits ineligible and recorded.
conditional_classification.reference: Fit corresponding sklearn estimators on identical train features/scaling; save validation confusion matrices, score differences and prediction agreement for every configuration. No equality assumption for CART ties.
conditional_classification.scope: Classification with reference-region geometry supplied; not end-to-end detection.

detection.candidate_input: Apply configured filter to linear T11, then same log/percentile transform as above; threshold dark pixels. No ground-truth mask at inference.
detection.classifier: Frozen winner from conditional validation; candidate features use fixed feature_image, not reference labels.
detection.selection: Highest validation mean of oil object-F1 and look-alike object-F1; ties use candidate list order. Do not retrain after selecting.
detection.ground_truth: Keep all oil/look-alike reference components. Unknown-color pixels ignored only during evaluation. Land and sea are not silently removed from predictions; false detections count as FP.
detection.matching: One-to-one same-class IoU >=0.5. Report per-class TP/FP/FN, P/R/F1, mean class F1, and spatially matched cross-class confusion plus unmatched objects.
detection.min_area_scope: 64-pixel candidate filter inherited from SOS, not applied to ground truth. Also report GT counts/recall by <64 and >=64 pixels without replacing overall metrics.

test_rule: No test model score until both selections and model hashes are saved. Evaluate frozen winners once, report poor results without retuning. Test prediction labels withheld from selection.
limits: Generic look-alike only, no wind/biofilm/rain causal labels.
UAVSAR L-band supplementary branch; does not replace SOS Sentinel/PALSAR results.
Five test images yield fragile estimates; object counts are not independent image or scene counts.
No physical calibration or georeferenced wind evaluation is implied.

revision.reason: Exact translated overlap crosses train/test in v1 (21/22); repair before fitting.
revision.selection_rule: Preserve 14/5/5 total and 10/3/3 dominant-oil counts; enumerate all eligible oil-group assignments, minimize changed image membership, tie-break SHA256 of seed2026 plus canonical split JSON. No model scores read.
revision.prior_exposure: All images/masks visually audited. V1 train/validation features extracted before grouping; no classifier fitted and no model scores. Revised test is not claimed visually blind.
